_about: Torpido design tokens: the single source for colours, type, spacing, radius and motion. Role names follow replica-design; values are Torpido's own (DESIGN.md), not CarTV's. scripts/gen_theme.py writes App/Design/Theme.generated.swift and the colour sets in App/Assets.xcassets from this file. Check every change with: python3 contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json
_original: CarTV, measured 2026-10-20 from the owner's 384x848 WhatsApp-compressed recording (approximate): iOS light grouped style, bg ~#F2F2F7, surface #FFFFFF, accent system green ~#1FCF55 on empty-state and paywall buttons, text-muted ~#8E8E93, dark photo-led paywall. Recorded as roles only; none of these values are used.
_composited: Translucent iOS system colours are stored as their composited value over the surface they sit on, so contrast is measured on what is drawn.

font.sans: SF Pro (system), Dynamic Type text styles
font.display: SF Pro Expanded Black (system width .expanded, weight .black) - the marquee name only

shadow._rule: No drop shadows. Light is the only lift: bulb glow is a radial gradient (accent 0.55 -> 0).

motion.system: push, sheet and tab transitions stay system; Reduce Motion stops the chase
